definition.lineCounting: Physical lines are split on LF, CRLF, or CR; a terminal newline does not create an extra line. Counted lines contain at least one non-whitespace character after Unicode whitespace trimming. Comments and documentation count as source lines.
definition.scope: The deduplicated union of first-party Lean files supplied in the checked local source closures for artifacts at one pinned package commit. External dependencies such as Mathlib are excluded.
